Goin' Down The Road Feelin' Bad

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Other One** (4 reviews): Phil is outstanding throughout, especially late when he jams alone; After Truckin' ends, it takes at least twenty minutes before Weir begins singing in the Other One [5][6][7][8]
- **Goin' Down The Road Feelin' Bad** (3 reviews): Reviewer singles out the lead solo from about 4:15 on as exquisite and raw, unlike other versions heard; Reviewer finds it very hot even by 1972 standards; the final Not Fade Away cuts out [4][9][10]
- **Playing In The Band** (1 review): Reviewer calls the jam stunning, melting and oozing [8]
- **Stella Blue** (1 review): Full of feeling, though Jerry forgets the lyrics two or three times [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Hey Bo Diddley**: rare: 5 archived performances [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1972-08-22.sbd.miller.27780.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 24 songs; 184 min; rated 4.09/5 by 11 [1]. Said about its sound: The first few notes of Bertha are missing, and the second Not Fade Away cuts at 1:18; Piano distortion, channel loss and level changes in Loser (mostly fixed), and midway first-set hiss after a level change [1]
- **gd72-08-22.sbd.cotsman.11472.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 156 min; rated 4.86/5 by 7 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes a short cut in the middle of Tennessee Jed; Truckin' mix improves considerably about eight minutes in and stays better through the end of the show; The recording is missing the first three and a half songs [2][8][9]
- **gd1972-08-22.sbd.kaplan.7285.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 92 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]

## Around the show

- Donna and Bobby are audibly rocking off-mic when the vocals begin in Goin' Down The Road [10]
- The Dead played Berkeley Community Theater on August 21, 22, 24 and 25, 1972 [12]
- Reviewer ranks it possibly the best 1972 show, preferring it over the Spring tour, Oregon show and Fall tour [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1972-08-22.sbd.miller.27780.shnf**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Set 1 : SBD -> Master Reel (10 inch Master Reels @ 7.5ips 1/2trk) -> Apogee AD500 -> Master Dat (Panasonic SV3800/48k). Set 2 : SBD -> Master Reel (10 inch… [1]. Also: Pops were removed using Cool Edit Pro 2.0, and disc transitions are seamless [1]
- **gd72-08-22.sbd.cotsman.11472.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Transferred via Mike Dolgushkin and Seth Kaplan, then seeded to etree by J. Cotsman [2]
- **gd1972-08-22.sbd.kaplan.7285.shnf**: transferred by Seth Kaplan; source: Soundboard [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by arizjones.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead, Berkeley Community Theatre, Berkeley, CA. August 1972, three shows. (SBD)](https://arizjones.blogspot.com/2015/10/grateful-dead-berkeley-community.html) [17]
